scope: Generic canonical pivotal construction; no concrete category.

steps.source_locator: EGNO equations (8.30) and (8.35), printed pages 214 and 217

source_locators: EGNO calls (8.30) a natural transformation, printed page 214
formal_proof_route: Braiding swaps the chosen exact pairing, making X a right dual of X*.
Uniqueness of right duals gives the objectwise inverse.
Braiding naturality plus evaluation and coevaluation mate identities prove naturality.
NatIso.ofComponents derives inverse naturality from objectwise isomorphisms.

steps.source_locator: EGNO Proposition 8.9.3 and equation (8.31), printed pages 214-215
formal_proof_route: The composite mopFunctor followed by unmopFunctor has positive double braiding as its tensorator.
Mathlib monoidal composition supplies the tensorator coherence laws.
Transport across the Drinfeld natural isomorphism constructs a coherent monoidal structure on the right double-dual functor.
This roadmap adopts EGNO equation (8.31) as the characterization of the standard double-dual tensorator.
The transported tensorator makes the Drinfeld monoidal defect exactly positive monodromy.
The balancing law cancels that monodromy and proves theta_X followed by u_X is monoidal.

steps.source_locator: EGNO Proposition 8.10.12 and equation (8.41), printed page 220
formal_proof_route: Dual uniqueness proves that the Drinfeld comparison preserves evaluation and coevaluation.
The canonical pivotal dimension reduces to the explicit ribbon loop in equation (8.41).
Braiding naturality cancels the inverse crossing from the swapped coevaluation against the positive crossing in the dual loop.
The evaluation mate law moves theta_(X*) across the cap.
The ribbon dual law identifies its mate with theta_(X**), and twist naturality moves that twist through the Drinfeld comparison.
The resulting ribbon loop for X* equals the ribbon loop for X, proving dim(X)=dim(X*).
steps.scope_note: The Lean proof establishes the ribbon-to-spherical direction directly for braided right-rigid categories. It does not use semisimplicity or prove the converse direction.

formal_proof_route: Expand the pivotal trace as coevaluation, the coupon composite followed by the pivotal map, and evaluation.
Move the first coupon across the coevaluation; the mate identity turns it into its right dual.
Move that right dual across the evaluation; the second mate identity turns it into the right double dual.
Naturality of the pivotal isomorphism rewrites a_X followed by f** as f followed by a_Y.
The remaining composite is exactly the trace cut after the other coupon.
steps.scope_note: Cyclicity is proved for every pivotal right-rigid monoidal category. Sphericality and semisimplicity are not used. EGNO Theorem 4.7.15 concerns equality of left and right traces and is not claimed here.

formal_proof_route: The interface stores a finite duplicate-free complete skeleton of simple representatives.
Every object comes with an actual finite biproduct isomorphism to listed simple summands; numerical multiplicities alone are not accepted.
Finite-dimensional Hom spaces record local finiteness, while the explicit decomposition records finite semisimplicity.
The tensor unit is stored as a listed simple representative, a strengthened finite-semisimple presentation of EGNO's End(1)=K condition.
Schur's lemma over the pinned algebraically closed field derives the canonical scalar equivalence K ≃ End(1).
Closed-diagram scalarization and its identity, additive, scalar, and composition laws are derived from that equivalence and cannot be caller-overridden.
Every object, and in particular every tensor product of simples, receives a proved finite identity resolution.
Binding a RibbonStructure to the fusion data derives the previously established pivotal, spherical, trace, and quantum-dimension interfaces.
steps.scope_note: This is a generic proof-relevant fusion-category interface. It does not instantiate a concrete category or yet prove nondegeneracy and transport compatibility of the trace pairing.

step_1_guards: mirror braiding cannot definitionally replace equation (8.30)
inverse twist cannot definitionally replace equation (8.35)

step_2_guards: objectwise isomorphisms without a naturality witness are rejected
a forward morphism without inverse data is rejected as a NatIso component
single-dual f* cannot replace the required double-dual f**
the right double-dual functor compiles from RightRigidCategory alone
step_3_guards: mirror monodromy cannot replace positive monodromy
the ordinary identity tensorator cannot silently replace the monodromy tensorator
the Drinfeld morphism cannot be treated as monoidal without its positive-monodromy defect
the canonical pivotal structure is constructed only after NatTrans.IsMonoidal is proved
step_4_guards: a balanced twist without the ribbon dual law cannot authorize the spherical construction
the positive crossing in the ribbon loop cannot silently be replaced by its mirror
the dual twist theta_(X*) cannot silently be replaced by its inverse
sphericality is derived as a theorem rather than inserted as an independent field value
step_5_guards: objectwise maps X -> X** without naturality and monoidality cannot be used as a pivotal structure
cut movement reverses the cyclic order g after f and does not silently dualize the coupons
SphericalCutTrace is constructed from a proved trace law instead of a hand-written cyclic equality
trace cyclicity does not silently claim equality of left and right traces
step_6_guards: a finite list without a completeness proof is rejected
numerical fusion multiplicities without actual biproduct isomorphisms are rejected
isomorphic duplicate simple representatives without a pairwise guard are rejected
a unit label without an isomorphism to the tensor unit is rejected
a dual label without an isomorphism from the selected categorical dual is rejected
closed-diagram scalarization cannot be overridden as a data field
fusion data without a RibbonStructure cannot authorize canonical pivotal, spherical, or quantum-dimension data
explicit_non_claims: No independent braiding-free construction of the duality-induced double-dual tensorator has been compared with the equation-(8.31)-characterized tensorator.
The converse implication from sphericality of a canonical pivotal structure to the ribbon dual law has not been formalized because the downstream construction only needs ribbon-to-spherical.
EGNO Theorem 4.7.15, equality of left and right traces in a spherical tensor category, has not been formalized because pivotal cyclicity is the only cut-moving theorem needed here.
The nondegenerate trace pairing and its mate and functor compatibility have not yet been derived from the fusion interface.
No Kirby-colour expansion or category-bound Kirby move has yet been derived.
No concrete category has been instantiated.
